chunks: And from him, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Fadalah, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) when he began the prayer raising his hands slightly below his face.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq raise his hands at the beginning of prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific practice of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in raising his hands slightly below the face during the opening of prayer, offering a nuanced detail to the ritual of *ruku'* preparation. In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith is often cited to discuss the preferred manner of *raf' al-yadayn*, distinguishing between raising them to the ears versus the shoulders, and underscores the importance of following the Imams' precise physical conduct in worship. It serves as a key evidence for the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt in shaping the visual and spiritual discipline of the believer during salat.
